title: Text or a number?
heading: Try it: add the quotes.
description: Try the suggestions below, one at a time. Press Run after each one and compare what the fox says.

scene.title: Your fox. Your words.
scene.label: A fox in a meadow. Spoken values appear in a speech bubble.

feedback.initial: Run the sum first. Then put quotes around each number: "3" + "4". Run again.
feedback.success: 3 + 4 gives 7. "3" + "4" gives 34. With integers, + adds; with strings, + joins the text.
